sheet_name: ST (ระดับชั้นที่ 1 - ชานพัก)
source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06_หน้า43.png
warnings: Lower stair flight: from ระดับพื้นชั้น 1 up to the ชานพัก (half-landing). The upper flight, landing to floor 2, is on S-17/หน้า44. Together they are the 'ST' marked at ~D1 on the floor plans (S-04/S-05).

Geometry read straight off the printed chains: 10 risers @0.175 = 1.75m total rise, 9 treads @0.25 = 2.25m going, landing 1.20m long, 3.45m overall horizontally. Waist slab 0.125m thick; the landing thickens to 0.30m where it frames into the beam.

Supports: the landing end sits on B2 with a CN column under it (the column is marked just 'CN' on this sheet — the column table S-13/หน้า40 has CN1 'ขึ้นจากชั้น 1 – ถึงชานพัก', which is this one); the bottom of the flight lands on B6 at ระดับพื้นชั้น 1.

The flight carries five distinct printed rebar leaders and they are recorded individually in bar_layers rather than squeezed into a single main_bar, because a stair's top steel, bottom steel, distribution steel and step-corner bars are different bars doing different jobs. Bar extension lengths printed along the slope (0.70, 0.40, 1.00 and the 0.40 into the landing) are kept in each layer's note.

'ø9มม.ทุกมุม' means one Ø9 bar at EVERY step corner (nosing and internal corner), and 'ø9มม.@ตามแบบ' means Ø9 spaced as drawn rather than at a stated pitch — neither can be turned into a spacing_mm, so both are recorded with spacing null and the printed text preserved.
Bar-type convention: ø9มม recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม as 'DB' (deformed). The sheet prints only 'ø'.
No stair PLAN is given on this sheet — flight width is not dimensioned anywhere in the structural set, so no width is recorded.
